decision: Narrow: pan and zoom are continuous on the recorded workload; hourly time changes at the gate's 30 inputs/s still show loading. The continuous-weather acceptance check is not met.
failing_check: weather remains current during every interaction input
endpoint: QQuickWindow.afterRendering proxy, NOT presentation FPS, scanout, or input-to-present
pan_loading_runs: one run of 5 consecutive inputs (21-25) at the 128 MiB setting; the rest of the 120 inputs were ready
time_loading_pattern: the second and third inputs of each three-hour block load; exact-event inputs are ready. Each unseen open interval is a full field preparation (~0.2-0.4 s), faster than the gate's 30 inputs/s sweep.
store_finding: 33 prepared fields were resident in 58.8 MB with no evictions, so the 32 MiB store was not the time-phase cause; it was replaced with the 128 MiB decoded-band ceiling to retain the working set.
limits: No claim of continuous weather for hourly time changes at 30 inputs/s
Pan loading improved from 49 to 5 and zoom from 24 to 0 against the recorded reference; not a matched speedup claim
No direct hardware-upload or presentation-FPS measurement
No chart, fill, contour or routing integration
No new source-priority, interpolation or missing-data policy
Issue 64 original residency and fidelity acceptance is not discharged
next_step: Instrument prefetch target attempts/coverage in the gate output and prefer time-window prefetch once the camera is stationary, then rerun one native attempt. Do not extend the recorded budget silently.
